title: Godot 4 turned export / onready / tool into @ annotations

blocks.text:
Godot 4 replaced several GDScript keywords with @-prefixed annotations.
The three most important 3→4 changes are export → @export, onready →
@onready, and tool → @tool. Annotations are placed on the line before
(or on the same line as) the declaration they modify. Godot 4 also added
variants such as @export_range, @export_group, and @export_category that
did not exist as keywords in Godot 3.

# Godot 3                         # Godot 4
export var speed = 300.0          @export var speed: float = 300.0
onready var sprite = $Sprite2D    @onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D
tool                              @tool
